Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks for the questions and context. I’m Neha (Security Lead) — happy to provide details. Below are brief, consumer-friendly answers; we can provide formal SOW/DPA language and sample contract clauses for any adjustments you need.

1) SOC 2
- Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (Security) covering Nov 2024–Oct 2025.
- We can share the full report under a standard NDA. For quick review I’ve attached the executive summary (SOC2_report_redwood_2025-11.pdf).

2) DPA / BAA
- DPA: We have a standard DPA for GDPR compliance; it’s available via DocuSign and editable for enterprise terms.
- HIPAA BAA: We offer a HIPAA BAA for customers processing PHI. NOTE: BAAs are currently accepted for Dedicated and Private deployment modes by default. For Hosted API we can evaluate on a case-by-case basis (controls and contractual terms may differ).

3) Data deletion SLAs (general guidance)
- Primary systems: Standard deletion workflow removes customer data from active stores within 30 calendar days after a validated deletion request or contract termination. This includes prompt deletion of model inputs/outputs and associated metadata in active databases.
- Backups & snapshots: Backups are immutable snapshots stored for business continuity. By default, backup retention is 180 days. When a deletion request is processed we mark data for purging; however, immutable backups are on a separate retention cadence and may require up to 90 additional days to be purged depending on the snapshot window. We can negotiate shorter backup retention windows in the contract (e.g., 30/60/90 days) for enterprise customers.
- Audit & confirmation: We provide a deletion report and audit log entry for each validated deletion request. For formal requests we’ll provide a signed certificate of destruction once the deletion workflow completes.

4) Logs & telemetry
- Default retention: Request logs and access logs are retained for 90 days by default to support debugging and incident investigations.
- Shorter retention: Customers can request shorter retention (minimum 30 days) subject to account configuration and contract terms.
- Redaction: We support request-level redaction of prompt/response content and can disable the storage of request/response bodies for sensitive routes when configured on Dedicated/Private deployments.

5) Backups nuances and edge cases
- SLA for deletion from backups: Because backups are immutable snapshots, a full removal from cold storage can take up to the next snapshot/retention cycle. For customers requiring immediate purging from backups, we recommend Dedicated/Private deployments where snapshot policies can be tightly controlled, or a contractual commit that reduces backup retention.
- For regulated customers we offer a private deployment option with per-customer backup domains and shorter snapshot retention windows.

6) Vendor security questionnaire & next steps
- Vendor questionnaire: I’ve started the questionnaire at https://secure.redwood.com/questionnaire/amaya — Samir/Tom, your procurement can complete the sections on your side; our security team will fill the vendor-control items.
- Docs we can provide immediately: SOC2 executive summary (attached), standard DPA (DocuSign link below), pen-test summary, encryption and key-management overview.

DocuSign / Docs:
- DPA (sample): https://www.docusign.com/na/documents/DOC-982374
- Questionnaire: https://secure.redwood.com/questionnaire/amaya

If this looks reasonable I can: (a) share a redlined DPA/BAA, (b) provide a short deletion-SLA clause to add to the contract, and (c) join the vendor-review call the week of Mar 8.
